Thereafter the foremost of monkeys, the son of Bali, Angada,

" 0 Virtuous King, this is no ambassador, he has the appear-

arrested, do not allow him to return to Lanka. Such is my 
opinion." 
Thereupon at a sign from the king, the monkeys flung them-
selves on that titan, whom they seized and bound, whilst he, 
without defence, wailed loudly. 
Ill-treated by those furious monkeys, Shuka began to cry 
upon the magnanimous Rama, born of Dasaratha, saying :-
" They are tearing out my wings ruthlessly and putting out 
my eyes, may the consequences of all the evil deeds that I have 
done since the day I was born till the night I die, fall on thee if 
I lose my life ! " 
Hearing his cries, Rama would not sanction his death and 
ordered the monkeys to release him.

brief.summary_1line: After the ocean ignores his prayers for passage, Rama angrily unleashes arrows into the sea to force Sagara to respond.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands on the seashore with blazing eyes, drawing his mighty bow as flaming arrows plunge into the ocean and churn the waters into towering waves.
Rama lies on darbha grass beside the vast ocean for three nights in silent prayer, facing east with folded hands under the open sky.
Terrified sea creatures, serpents, and demons flee as Rama’s arrows strike the ocean, sending shells and spray high into the air.
